register: Respectful concise plural imperatives (करा, निवडा, जतन करा); तुमचे/तुम्ही consistently; labels compact, complete sentences natural rather than word substitution. Avoid Hindi-only morphology such as हैं/करें/आपका. Preserve Latin product names and key bindings where identifiers.

sources.interpretation: कामगार is attested for workers and suits autonomous gathering/building units; use Marathi case endings in sentences.

sources.consulted: Marathi text on accounts, stored content, Xbox privacy settings
sources.interpretation: Contemporary software usage supports खाते for account, जतन for save, सेटिंग्ज for settings. Source is usage evidence, not a grammar authority.

sources.title: प्रमाणलेखन नियमावली — भाषा संचालनालय, महाराष्ट्र शासन
sources.consulted: PDF pages 10–11, printed pages 1–2; rules 1–5 and explanation of सामान्यरूप. Cover and foreword also visually inspected.
sources.interpretation: Use anusvara on nasal sounds and plural oblique forms with case endings; distinguish singular/plural forms (घरातील / घरांतील). Use standard written Marathi rather than obsolete unnecessary nasal signs. Sanskrit-derived final i/u word vowels become long in Marathi except specified indeclinables. These rules guide inflection and spelling without dictating gameplay terminology.

terminology_rationales.rationale: Attested Marathi worker term; source mechanic is autonomous gathering/building.

Contextual terminology decision: short Marathi agent noun for units that scout and reveal terrain, distinguishable from योद्धा. English [explorationflag explanation] says Attracts explorers and introduction instructions say scout with a flag. No external dictionary attestation claimed for this choice.
Combat unit; standard Marathi/Sanskrit-derived noun shared with Hindi, not a reason to replace.
Gameplay [inn explanation] = Feeds your units. खानावळ emphasizes feeding rather than a generic lodging house; preserve conversion attraction in any longer instructions that mention it.
Building that creates units. French Ruche and Hindi छत्ता establish hive concept; avoid generic थवा/झुंड for building. Inflect पोळ्यात/पोळ्याचे naturally.
Fruit exchange building; no financial stock-exchange interpretation.
Assignment/attention marker. Do not suggest direct unit orders. Inflect ध्वजाचा/ध्वजाकडे.
Player-controlled collective; distinguish team संघ and building पोळे.
Mountain route, not pass/fail or permission.

Reviewed Marathi loanword for individual game entities, agreed in semantic/editorial glossary discussion. Counted plural %0 युनिट; use natural Marathi case endings. Distinguish statistical resource measurement units (एकके) from living game entities.
